summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The T-Rex 2X Long Apple Daily Target ETF (AAPX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund aims to provide 2x leveraged exposure to the daily price movement of Apple, Inc. stock, less fees, and expenses. AAPX was launched on Jan 11, 2024 and is issued by Tuttle Capital Management.

data.title: Investing In Big Tech With T-Rex 2X Long ETFs
data.text: We look for stocks that are super popular that people want to follow, notes Scott Acheychek. He discusses investing in big tech with T-Rex 2X/-2X ETFs.

data.title: REX Shares and Tuttle Capital Management Expand T-REX Single-Stock ETF Suite with Apple, Alphabet, and Microsoft Offerings
data.text: -REX remains the only ETFs in USA which provide precise 200% daily targeted exposure to Single Stocks such as Tesla, Nvidia and now Apple, Alphabet, and Microsoft
